requirements: The system shall allow users to create and manage their personal profiles, including setting dietary goals and preferences.
The system shall enable users to log and track their daily food intake, including meals, snacks, and beverages.
The system shall provide a database of common foods and their nutritional information for users to easily select and add to their logs.
The system shall calculate and display the user's daily nutritional intake, including macronutrients and micronutrients.
The system shall generate reports and charts to help users visualize their progress and identify trends in their eating habits.
The system shall allow users to set reminders and notifications to stay on track with their dietary goals.
The system shall integrate with popular wearable devices and health apps to import additional health data.
The system shall provide a social feature for users to share their progress and connect with friends or a community for support.
The system shall be accessible via a web interface and mobile app to accommodate different user preferences.
The system shall ensure the security and confidentiality of user data, including encryption and secure authentication.
The system shall be scalable to handle a large number of users and high traffic volumes.
The system shall have a user-friendly interface with intuitive navigation and minimal cognitive load.
The system shall be available 24/7, with a minimum uptime of 99.9% and prompt error resolution.
The system shall be compatible with multiple browsers, devices, and operating systems to ensure broad accessibility.
The system shall provide regular backups and data recovery options to prevent data loss.
The system shall comply with relevant regulations, such as GDPR and HIPAA, to ensure user data protection.

risk_report.risk: Requirements may be ambiguous or incomplete, leading to scope creep or misaligned deliverables.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct structured interviews and validate requirements with stakeholders through iterative reviews.

risk_report.risk: Overly complex or inflexible architecture may hinder scalability or future maintenance.
risk_report.mitigation: Adopt modular design principles and conduct architecture reviews with technical leads.

risk_report.risk: Poor schema design may cause performance bottlenecks or data integrity issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Normalize data where appropriate and conduct schema reviews with database experts.

risk_report.risk: Inconsistent or poorly documented APIs may lead to integration challenges for frontend or third parties.
risk_report.mitigation: Follow RESTful conventions and maintain an up-to-date API specification document.

risk_report.risk: Suboptimal code quality or lack of error handling may introduce bugs or security vulnerabilities.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce coding standards and conduct peer code reviews before merging changes.

risk_report.risk: Inconsistent UI/UX or unhandled edge cases may degrade user experience.
risk_report.mitigation: Use design systems and component libraries to ensure consistency and responsiveness.

risk_report.risk: Pipeline failures or misconfigurations may delay deployments or introduce broken code into production.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement automated testing in the pipeline and monitor pipeline health regularly.

risk_report.risk: Insufficient test coverage may allow undetected bugs to reach later stages.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce minimum test coverage thresholds and review test cases for critical paths.

risk_report.risk: Flaky or incomplete tests may lead to false confidence in code stability.
risk_report.mitigation: Use mocking and snapshot testing to ensure reliable and maintainable test suites.

risk_report.risk: Undetected integration issues between components may surface only in production.
